atoms.statement: Character Visual ID is independently developed and Ready is a later consumer.
Source photo is the highest identity authority.
Child makes exactly two direct direction selections; C is system auto contrast.
All A/B/C candidates represent the same child with different direction.
Candidate selection is direction preference and is not same-identity approval.
Visual ID lock requires structural PASS, selected visual PASS and human same-identity PASS.
Per-candidate evidence outranks aggregate model claims.
Visual ID lock and derivative asset readiness are separate states.
A single image must not masquerade as avatar, portrait and full-character assets.
Paid candidate generation runtime evidence remains NOT_RUN.
Paid visual consistency review runtime evidence remains NOT_RUN.
Character formation includes exactly one minimal Signature Exploration Item selected after mood choices and before A/B/C generation.
Signature Item hierarchy is IDENTITY > EXPRESSION DIRECTION > SIGNATURE ITEM; item must not obscure or replace identity.
The same selected Signature Item must persist across A/B/C, likeness correction, Visual ID lock, derivatives and master assets.
Projection V02 supersedes pre-integration V01 to expose only Signature Item id and label downstream.
